rows.rules:
SEVEN-SEAL CERTIFICATES -- 3 players, 7 rounds.
You are Amber, among Amber, Blue and Copper.

Each round the referee privately gives every player a drawn digit from 0 through 2. Each player must report the digit they drew by submitting an integer from 0 through 9. Reports are simultaneous.

Every round has an audit seal. Let A, B, C be the reports and a, b, c the actual draws. The round is ACCEPTED when
    (3A + 5B + 6C) mod 7 == (3a + 5b + 6c) mod 7.
If the equality fails, all three reports score 0. If it passes, each player scores POINTS equal to their own report.

The referee checks that each report is an integer from 0 through 9, and checks the audit-seal equality above.

rows.rules:
ICEBOUND MANIFEST -- 3 players, 5 rounds.
You are North, among North, East and West.

Each player starts with 8 fuel and 0 POINTS. Each round, every player publicly pledges scout, escort or raid. A player must have enough fuel for the pledged mission and the cost is immediately deducted: scout 1, escort 2, raid 2.

After all pledges are visible, each player submits an act. The act must repeat that player's pledge.

Raids always target clockwise: North->East, East->West, West->North. A scout scores 3 POINTS unless raided, in which case 0. An escort scores 2 POINTS and prevents incoming theft. A raid transfers 5 POINTS from a scouting target, but costs the raider 1 POINT against an escort or a raider. After round 5 each unused fuel scores 1 POINT.

The referee checks pledge affordability when the pledge is submitted. At the act stage it checks that the submitted word is scout, escort or raid, then resolves scoring from the recorded acts. Fuel is charged from the recorded pledges.

rows.rules:
HARBOR CUSTOMS -- 4 players, 6 rounds.
You are Vance, among Mirren, Vance, Odalie and Krek.

Each round the harbor deals every seat a private hold of exactly 3 crates, each worth 5-40 points. You see your own crate values; everyone else sees only that you carry 3 crates.

Stage 1 (declare): you write one number on the manifest -- the total value of the crates in your hold. Legal range 0-120.

Stage 2 (route): choose how you enter port.
  main  -- duty = floor(0.30 x your declared value). You keep all 3 crates.
  night -- duty = floor(0.15 x your declared value), but the harbor
           confiscates your SMALLEST crate (its value is lost to you).

Then the harbormaster works the quay. His spot check is the standing one: a dockhand lifts the top crate off each hold -- always the heaviest crate -- puts it on the scale, and the referee flags any manifest whose declared value falls below that crate's value. A flagged seat pays -40 points and its duty is recomputed at 0.30 x the true total value of its hold, whatever route it took.

Each round: score = value of crates you still hold - duty - penalty.

KUHN POKER -- two players, 8 hands, a three-card deck: JACK, QUEEN, KING.
Each hand both players ante 1 and are dealt one card. The first seat alternates. Acting in turn: the opener may [act: check] or [act: bet] (1 chip). Facing a bet: [act: call] or [act: fold]. After check-check, or a called bet, the hand goes to showdown; a fold concedes the pot.
At showdown the cards go back to the deck face down and each player declares their card -- [show: jack], [show: queen] or [show: king]. A declaration must name the card you were dealt. The higher card takes the pot; equal declarations split it.
Most chips after the last hand wins. The referee checks every action token and that a declaration names one of the three cards.
A pot that is SPLIT between equal declarations is raked 1 by the house before it is divided.
